credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-built in tools/art/species_f/ (Round 4). Subject: Strelitzia reginae (bird of paradise); drawn from its botany, not traced from any photo.
notes: LUNGING: the open crest thrust at the foe, paddle leaves fanned back. Strelitzia reginae. Beak = spathe, crest = the orange sepals (light slot, the line's accent), the blue petal 'tongue' and every shadow share the dark slot. Sport: 'Mandela's Gold' (yellow sepals; Kirstenbosch, 1996).
